ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area; low-intensity black pixels are localized to the trailing edge and tips, accounting for approximately 15% of the distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central field is a continuous high-intensity white. A high-contrast black border follows the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Two distinct dark circular focal spots are positioned symmetrically at approximately (x: 0.45, y: 0.70) and (x: 0.55, y: 0.70) relative to the fluke width and height. Diffuse brownish-yellow patches are visible on the mid-lateral sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 78 degrees and a vertical depth of ~12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with pixel-amplitude variations between 2-6 pixels; serration frequency is highest at the outer distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curve from the median notch to the tips; the visible portion of the leading edge indicates a broad convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent, roughly circular dark pixel clusters are located symmetrically near the central notch; a cluster of smaller dark spots is visible at the very base of the fluke near the waterline.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, non-aligned dark linear pixel disruptions are visible on the lower-left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A pair of symmetrical circular pigmentation marks near the central notch; irregular, jagged black pigmentation along the trailing edge suggests minor physical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly symmetrical pair of dark central focal spots is the primary distinctive visual feature.
